people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: All the offspring of Israel will be justified in Yahweh, and will rejoice!
translations.bsb: In the LORD all descendants of Israel will be justified and will exult.
translations.kjv: In the LORD shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.
translations.asv: In Jehovah shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.
